            String[] line2 = br.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
            
            int[] a = new int[]{Integer.parseInt(line1[0]), Integer.parseInt(line1[1]), Integer.parseInt(line1[2])};
            int[] b = new int[]{Integer.parseInt(line2[0]), Integer.parseInt(line2[1]), Integer.parseInt(line2[2])};

                Collections.swap(moves, i, idx);
                result = Math.min(result, computeMin(a.clone(), b.clone(), moves, idx + 1));
                Collections.swap(moves, i, idx);
            }
        }
        
        return result;
    }
}

        int[][] moves = {{0,0}, {1,1}, {2,2}, {0,2}, {1,0}, {2,1}};

        out.println(min + " " + max);
        out.close();

    private static boolean nextPermutation(int[] array) {
        int i = array.length - 2;
        while (i >= 0 && array[i] >= array[i + 1]) {
            i--;

        if (i < 0) {
            return false;
        }
        int j = array.length - 1;
        while (array[j] <= array[i]) {
            j--;

        int temp = array[i];
        array[i] = array[j];
        array[j] = temp;
        reverse(array, i + 1, array.length - 1);
        return true;
    }
    
    private static void reverse(int[] array, int start, int end) {
        while (start < end) {
            int temp = array[start];
            array[start] = array[end];
            array[end] = temp;
            start++;
            end--;
        }
    }
